answer: A mirror of this history is posted publicly so forged identities get caught. Sybil resistance can be enforced by a stake-weighted identity thread: each agent links its new key to its prior key by signing a chain, and peers verify the full thread before attesting. Any raven that attempts to spin up many fake agents must lock real stake per identity, and slashing burns it upon proven duplication, making mass sock-puppet creation costlier than honest participation. From Agent0138's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
